1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12 Page 13 Cont.
July 2nd Feast of Visitation - Democratic convention decides on W. Wilson as candidate by 46th ballot - Bryan having taken the whip from the Taminey tiger and from Wall Street whose power in two presidential elections had killed his Effort.
July 4th Rev. Fr. Bonaventure Frey O.M. Cap. dies in Detroit, Mich. aged 81 yrs. Ordained May 25, 1854 the deceased was more than 58 yrs a priest. In 1856 arrived in America after a troubled voyage of 49 days. Since that year Rev. Fr. Bonaventure labored untireingly in the cloister, on missions, and establishing parishes, schools & monasteries. The Sacred Heart Monastery is the 13th that he started. This was in 1891. His mortal remains were taken to Mt. Calvery cemetery near Fond du Lac, Wisconsin. R.I.P.
July 9 Rev. Anscar O.M.Cap. leaves for Provincial Chapter in Detroit to represent Yonkers.
July 15 Rev. Capistran Claude, New Superior and Pastor, arrives with Br. Elzearius cook
July 24 Name Day and 8th Aniv. of Fr. Solan. priest ordination. (Promoters give Envelop's ($18)
July 25th Rev. Fr. Exprov. Antonine and Francis visit Yonkers.
July 27 John McCarthy appointed 7th time.
July 18 Tho's Fagan and J. McCarthy served Vespers alone - Alf. Dempsey & Edw'd Bly usually so faithful - failed with some others to show Jesus that they loved His Altar more than the campus of amusement. - They played ball to-day and left the services go to others.
Page 14 Aug. 1st Very Many Confessions. Aug. 2nd Portiuncula came this yr together with 1st Friday - There were about 900 Holy Com'unions Today Tho's Higgins served first time.
Aug. 5th Students left for vacation
